## Fixes

- Android: the app closed when you tapped Scan QR code to pair a PC. Scanning works again.

## New

- Android shell: a sticky SHIFT key in the key row. It upper-cases the next character, turns TAB into Shift+Tab, and selects with the arrows, HOME/END and PGUP/PGDN. CTRL and ALT now also work with those keys (Ctrl+← jumps a word).
